title: 第一章 你去给她道个歉
content_zh:
宣云溪撞见男友霍廷深出轨后，果断甩了他一巴掌提出分手。

    当晚，她做了一个梦。

    梦里两人不仅复合了，还火速结婚并生了两个孩子！

    ……

    妈的，什么噩梦！

    她气得掐了自己一把，顺利从梦里醒来，还没来得及松口气，就听到有人在喊自己：

    “妈妈，你醒了？”

    揉了揉惺忪的睡眼，宣云溪闻到病房里特有的消毒水味，恍惚间看见两个小豆丁爬在病床前，一脸担忧地看着她。

    “妈妈，你头还疼不疼？”

    这两个小豆丁一男一女，小女孩和自己长得一模一样，小男孩和霍廷深相貌如出一辙，一瞬间，宣云溪头皮炸开了。

    “你们两个是谁？？？”

    不是吧！不是吧！她的噩梦不会成真了吧？

    “妈妈，你不认识我们了吗？你是不是不想要我们了？”

    小女孩嘴巴一扁，伤心地哭了起来。小男孩先把妹妹拽到身后，抽出一张纸巾帮她擦了擦眼泪，又转回来道：“我叫霍逸，妹妹叫霍灵。妈妈，你为什么不认识我们了？你是不是失忆了？”

    电视上都是这么演的。

    从楼梯上摔下来后，突然记不得身边的人和事了。

    宣云溪张了张嘴，不知道该说什么好。

    她快速平复了一下心情，犹疑着道：“你们的爸爸是谁，霍廷深吗？”

    “嗯，爸爸是叫霍廷深，霍氏集团的掌权人，全国最有钱的男人，也是最帅的，学历很高，性格很酷。”

    怕妈妈对爸爸一无所知了，他多解释了两句。

    宣云溪偷偷打量着这两个小豆丁。

    叫霍逸的小男孩有点高冷，一双黑曜石般得眼睛盯着窗外，一副满不在乎的模样，实则眼底带着一丝紧张。

    叫霍灵的小女孩有点胆小，躲在哥哥身后眼睛红红地偷看她，一副想要上前抱抱妈妈又不敢的样子。

    宣云溪手伸进被子里，偷偷掐了自己一把。

    嘶～好疼！

    所以，这不是梦。

    她真的和霍廷深结婚了，还生了俩孩子。

    可是，这怎么会呢？
content_en:
After Xuanyunxi caught her boyfriend Huo Tingshen cheating on her, she slapped him decisively and broke up with him.

    That night, she had a dream.

    In the dream, not only did the two get back together, they quickly got married and had two children!

    …

    Damn, what a nightmare!

    She was so angry that she pinched herself and woke up from her dream smoothly. Before she could breathe a sigh of relief, she heard someone calling her:

    "Mom, are you awake?"

    Rubbing her sleepy eyes, Xuanyunxi smelled the unique smell of disinfectant in the ward, and vaguely saw two little cubs crawling in front of the hospital bed, looking at her with worried faces.

    "Mom, does your head still hurt?"

    These two little beauties were a boy and a girl. The little girl looked exactly like him, and the boy looked exactly like Huo Tingshen. In an instant, Xuanyunxi's scalp exploded.

    “Who are you two???”

    No! No! Her nightmare won't come true, right?

    "Mom, don't you recognize us anymore? Do you not want us anymore?"

    The little girl flattened her mouth and cried sadly. The little boy first pulled his sister behind him, took out a tissue and wiped her tears, then turned back and said, "My name is Huo Yi, and my sister's name is Huo Ling. Mom, why don't you recognize us? Have you lost your memory?"

    That's how it's done on TV.

    After falling down the stairs, I suddenly couldn't remember the people and things around me.

    Xuanyun Xi opened his mouth, not knowing what to say.

    She calmed down quickly and said hesitantly: "Who is your father, is Huo Tingshen?"

    "Well, my father's name is Huo Tingshen. He is the leader of the Huo Group. He is the richest man in the country and the most handsome. He has a high degree of education and a cool personality."

    Afraid that his mother would know nothing about his father, he explained a few more sentences.

    Xuanyunxi secretly looked at these two little beans.

    The little boy named Huo Yi is a little cold, with a pair of obsidian eyes staring out the window, looking nonchalant, but in fact there is a trace of nervousness in his eyes.

    The little girl named Huo Ling was a little timid. She hid behind her brother and peeked at her with red eyes, as if she wanted to go forward and hug her mother but didn't dare.

    Xuanyun Xi reached into the quilt and pinched himself secretly.

    Hiss~ It hurts!

    So, this is not a dream.

    She really married Huo Tingshen and gave birth to two children.

    But, how could this happen?
title_en: Chapter 1 Go and apologize to her
